title: QuorRetr: Calibrated Evidence Retrieval for Patents
text:
QuorRetr: Calibrated Evidence Retrieval for Patents

Abstract. We present QuorRetr, a retrieval model for patents. The approach is complementary to reranking and can be combined with any generator. Negative sampling strategy has a noticeable effect on convergence speed. QuorRetr is evaluated on LexiNLI, BioHopQA and ChronoNewsQA.

title: QuorRetr: Calibrated Evidence Retrieval for Patents
text:
QuorRetr is evaluated on LexiNLI, BioHopQA and ChronoNewsQA.

1 Introduction. Prior work has largely evaluated retrievers on clean benchmarks with a single relevant passage. Our design keeps the retriever lightweight so that it can be deployed on commodity hardware. Error analysis reveals that long multi-part questions remain challenging. Retrieval-augmented systems often fail silently when the supporting evidence is missing.

title: QuorRetr: Calibrated Evidence Retrieval for Patents
text:
often fail silently when the supporting evidence is missing.

2 Related Work. Earlier retrievers such as BM25 and ANCE were tuned on SciClaimQA and CodeSeekBench. Hyperparameters were selected on the development split only. Unlike systems built for MedFactCheck, QuorRetr targets patents. Qualitative inspection suggests that retrieved passages are more focused than those of prior systems.

title: QuorRetr: Calibrated Evidence Retrieval for Patents
text:
passages are more focused than those of prior systems.

3 Method. QuorRetr is built on top of a MiniLM encoder. Hyperparameters were selected on the development split only. The encoder stack of QuorRetr has 12 transformer layers. Each layer of QuorRetr uses a hidden size of 768. We argue that robust systems must expose calibrated confidence to downstream components.

title: QuorRetr: Calibrated Evidence Retrieval for Patents
text:
must expose calibrated confidence to downstream components.

4 Training Setup. We train QuorRetr for 3 epochs. Optimisation of QuorRetr uses AdamW with a learning rate of 5e-5. Training batches for QuorRetr contain 256 examples. We leave the extension to multilingual settings for future work.

title: QuorRetr: Calibrated Evidence Retrieval for Patents
text:
leave the extension to multilingual settings for future work.

5 Results. On the LexiNLI test set, the full QuorRetr model attains 84.0 exact match. The BM25 baseline obtains 77.7 exact match on the LexiNLI test set. On the LexiNLI development split, QuorRetr records 87.1 exact match. On the BioHopQA test set, the full QuorRetr model attains 85.2 exact match. In comparison, ANCE scores 76.8 exact match on the BioHopQA test set. On the BioHopQA development split, QuorRetr records 86.9 exact match.

title: QuorRetr: Calibrated Evidence Retrieval for Patents
text: BioHopQA development split, QuorRetr records 86.9 exact match. For the ChronoNewsQA test split, we measure 76.5 exact match with the full QuorRetr model. The BM25 baseline obtains 69.5 exact match on the ChronoNewsQA test set. On the ChronoNewsQA development split, QuorRetr records 79.1 exact match.

title: QuorRetr: Calibrated Evidence Retrieval for Patents
text:
development split, QuorRetr records 79.1 exact match.

6 Ablations. Without its hard-negative mining, QuorRetr drops to 79.3 exact match on LexiNLI. We argue that robust systems must expose calibrated confidence to downstream components. Without its hard-negative mining, QuorRetr drops to 81.2 exact match on BioHopQA. We release our code and evaluation scripts to support reproducibility. Without its gating module, QuorRetr drops to 74.6 exact match on ChronoNewsQA.

title: QuorRetr: Calibrated Evidence Retrieval for Patents
text:
module, QuorRetr drops to 74.6 exact match on ChronoNewsQA. These findings indicate that confidence estimation and retrieval quality are tightly coupled.

7 Conclusion. Negative sampling strategy has a noticeable effect on convergence speed. We release our code and evaluation scripts to support reproducibility. We analyse failure cases and find that most errors stem from lexical mismatch between query and passage.
